test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ajay, Maya and Mohan started a business in partnership investing in the ratio of 11 : 16 : 6, respectively. At the end of the year, they earned a profit of ₹69,300, which is 70% of their total investment. How much did Maya invest (in ₹)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit is 70% of total investment

⇒ Total Investment = 69300 ÷ 0.7 = 99000

⇒ Ratio sum = 11 + 16 + 6 = 33, so 1 part = 99000 ÷ 33 = 3000

⇒ Maya's investment = 16 × 3000

**∴ Answer = 48000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of investments = 11 : 16 : 6, Profit = 69300 (which is 70% of total investment)

**Formula used:**

Profit = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Total Investment

**Calculation:**

⇒ (70 ÷ 100) × Total Investment = 69300

⇒ Total Investment = 69300 × 100 ÷ 70 = 99000

⇒ Total ratio = 11 + 16 + 6 = 33

⇒ Maya’s investment = (16 ÷ 33) × 99000

⇒ Maya’s investment = 16 × 3000 = 48000

**∴ The correct answer is 48000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Concept

Profit is shared in the ratio of Capital × Time invested.

Percentage Conversion

x% = x ÷ 100. Used to convert percentage into fraction.

Ratio Distribution

Individual share = (Part ÷ Total parts) × Total amount.
